brief:
Hussam Abu Safiya, a Palestinian doctor seized in Gaza, remains subject to torture by Israeli forces, according to Physicians for Human Rights, an Israel-based advocacy group. The organization reported that Abu Safiya has been beaten and subjected to sleep deprivation while in detention.

The case has drawn scrutiny from international human rights organizations monitoring the treatment of Palestinians held by Israeli forces during the conflict in Gaza. Physicians for Human Rights has documented conditions faced by detainees in Israeli custody, raising concerns about compliance with international law protecting prisoners from abuse.

title: Israel tortures abducted Palestinian doctor, rights group says
